title: Request Heuristics Sandbox Notebook — customer signal synthesis
summary: Working notebook synthesizing a week of recent customer threads into a compact heuristics sandbox. Goal: propose low-effort, testable runtime and API mitigations for recurring asks (latency cliffs, high embed costs, cache misses). Not a final plan — targeted at eng partnership for 1–2 week probes.
customer_quotes: "We see 5–15% of calls spike to 1.5–2x token cost for identical prompts — can't explain it to customers." — ML infra lead at midsize SaaS
"KV cache seems to help some sessions and not others; we can't tell when a user benefits." — Platform eng at retail company
"Embeddings cost is choking search P&L — if we could get 2x compression without accuracy regression we'd sign up for dedicated." — Head of AI at enterprise customer
priority_requests: Stable per-token latency guarantees or a clear SLI breakdown visible per-route
Better KV cache observability: hit rate per-customer, prefix fingerprinting, and TTL suggestions
A lower-cost, lower-accuracy quantized variant for embeddings with explicit quality signal
Batching controls at SDK level (per-request hints) so customers can trade latency vs unit cost
Failover rule that downgrades to a cheaper compatible model automatically when Dedicated capacity saturates
hypotheses: Latency spikes correlate with sudden distribution shifts (longer sequences + background GC on nodes) — not strictly model size
Per-customer cache fragmentation: many customers use ephemeral prefixes (chat starters) which reduces effective hit rate
Customers are over-invoking embeddings with full context; a short-context embedding tier would satisfy 60% of queries
SDK users aren't exposing request-level batching hints because the default interface hides them; ergonomics matter more than docs
proposed_experiments: Runtime probe: enable verbose per-request telemetry (token time, kernel-swap events) for 100 customers for 7 days — tag 'latency-lab'
Cache pilot: expose 'prefix-fingerprint' and per-session hit-rate in the Console for 10 beta accounts; collect qualitative feedback
Embedding microvariant: create a quantized-embed-compact model with a small eval set; ship behind a feature flag to compare accuracy/cost
SDK change: add optional 'batch_hint' field to request object (enum: latency|cost|balanced) and measure adoption in a 2-week A/B test
Failover policy test: implement canary that routes to rdw-small-2 when Dedicated pool CPU>85% for 5m; monitor error rate and customer-visible latency
engineering_notes: Estimated effort: telemetry probe (SRE + runtime) = 3 sprint-weeks; cache pilot (console + runtime) = 2 sprint-weeks
Watchouts: expanded telemetry will increase tracing costs — cap sampling to 20% for initial run
PR reference for async batch hooks: runtime PR #987 (staging tests green but needs perf validation)
KV cache TTL changes could interact with checkpointing — coordinate with release-engineering on migration window
monitoring_signals: Per-route p95 and p99 token latency (broken down by model variant)
KV cache hit-rate by customer and by session-start fingerprint
Embedding re-requests (same doc re-embedded within 24h) rate
Batch size distribution across SDK clients (percent of requests with >1 hinted batch)
Dedicated pool saturation and fallback frequency
open_questions: What fraction of embedding traffic is tolerant of 5–10% absolute quality drop? (need product & customer input)
Can we define a small, customer-visible signal that meaningfully predicts a cacheable prefix? (privacy constraints apply)
How will per-request batching hints interact with existing router grouping — do we need a routing priority override?
Legal: does exposing prefix fingerprints to Console create any PII risk for customers that send user-generated content?
decision_recs: Approve telemetry probe for an opt-in beta: tranche 100 accounts, 20% sample of their requests, 7 day window
Prioritize 'batch_hint' SDK ergonomics over a full batching UI — faster customer feedback loop
Create an embeddings microvariant behind a feature flag and run a focused accuracy/price tradeoff eval with 3 pilot customers
Add KV cache hit-rate to Console beta but mask raw prefixes; show aggregate metrics and per-session anonymized fingerprints
